sonnet.problem: Card 2 already asked which man people say has risen (John, Mark 6:14). Card 4 asks whether Herod lands on Elijah, and it is False only because Herod says John has risen (6:16). That re-asks the same point, since verses 14 and 16 both say John has risen. Card 3 also gives no context for Herod's own conclusion, so a baker can only guess at it.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The card says the girl's words are her mother's words 'with a platter and "immediately" added.' That isn't accurate. The mother said only "The head of John the Baptist" (6:24), and the girl's request also adds "I want you to give me" (6:25). The noticing claim is not strictly true.
sonnet.rule: Noticing. What he points out must be true. "Same words" means an exact match.
